schema_note: One window only, the plan's own. trip-windows/1 (overview spec 2.2) needs 2 to 4 windows, so this file keeps the same field names under trip-season-basic/1 and adds a `season` block in the adapter's Season shape.
months_basis_note: The plan's own month: the main plan runs through the middle of February.

sources.title: WMO Climate Normals 1991-2020, Daniel Oduber International Airport (78774)
sources.publisher: World Meteorological Organization, archived by NOAA NCEI (accession 0253808)

sources.title: WMO Climate Normals 1991-2020, Juan Santamaria International Airport (78762)
sources.publisher: World Meteorological Organization, archived by NOAA NCEI (accession 0253808)

points.name: Daniel Oduber airport climate station (Liberia)
points.note: Station coordinates as printed in the WMO file (10 35 N, 85 32 W). The plan's arrival airport; stands for the Guanacaste start of the trip.

points.name: Juan Santamaria airport climate station (Alajuela)
points.note: Station coordinates as printed in the WMO file (09 59 N, 84 10 W). The plan's departure airport in the Central Valley.

why.value: The plan's own dates, in the heart of the dry season: February is among the driest months at both airport stations.

tempC.value: 17 to 36 C at Liberia, 15 to 32 C at the San Jose airport (mean daily low to high in February)
tempC.note: WMO 1991-2020, February: Daniel Oduber max 36.2, min 16.9, mean 28.2; Juan Santamaria max 32.0, min 15.0, mean 22.9. Values as published; the files' mean is not the midpoint of max and min. Arenal, Manuel Antonio and Uvita have no station in the WMO set.

rain.value: Almost none at the two airports: about 2 mm at Liberia and 10 mm at San Jose in February, on about one day or less
rain.note: February precipitation 1.7 mm with 0.3 days >= 1 mm (Daniel Oduber); 10.4 mm with 1.1 days >= 1 mm (Juan Santamaria). Not measured for the Arenal or South Pacific bases.

daylight.value: Sunrise about 06:00, sunset about 17:45 to 17:50; just under 12 hours of day
daylight.note: core/bin/sun.ts for the first and last plan day: Liberia sunrise 06:03 to 06:00, sunset 17:49 to 17:52; San Jose airport sunrise 05:57 to 05:54, sunset 17:45 to 17:47; day 11h46m to 11h52m; civil dusk about 20 minutes after sunset.

notes.text: Civil dusk falls about 18:05 to 18:15 at both airports, so plan long drives to end by then
The Arenal and South Pacific bases are not covered by any normals station found

windows.label: Mid-February
windows.verdict_note: Not set: only the plan's own window was researched, so there is nothing to rank it against.
windows.best_for: A dry-season loop from Guanacaste to the Pacific coast

plus.text: Dry season: about 2 mm of rain in February at Liberia
Mild Central Valley nights, about 15 C at the San Jose airport

minus.text: Hot afternoons in Guanacaste, about 36 C at Liberia
Short days: civil dusk soon after 18:00, so no driving late in the day

unknown.text: Normals for La Fortuna and Arenal
